acceptance.detail: The self-test validates the frozen READY work order and exercises an allowed path and a protected path.
The fake-Codex lifecycle matrix remains incomplete. Current tests cover helper behavior, not the required runner and verifier success and failure cases.
Both wrappers show help and the recorded non-Darwin invocations stop with exit 2.
Preflight checks required flags in both help outputs and records the installed version and missing flags. It fails closed before model invocation.
Evidence records the required ledger, test-fast, diff-check, actionlint, and explicit ./dev verify command with passing output.

The driver stops after CLI preflight, so it does not execute the work-order lifecycle or a fresh read-only verifier. The installed CLI incompatibility explains the stop but does not satisfy this acceptance criterion.

scope_findings.finding: The summary converts unavailable token counts from null to zero, presenting unknown usage as measured zero. Preserve null when usage is unavailable; this is an in-scope correction.

Preflight searches help text with substring checks, so text containing a required flag as part of a longer option could be mistaken for exact flag support. Match parsed option tokens before relying on preflight to authorize execution.

risk_flags: New/resume orchestration, the verifier lifecycle, and the fake-Codex matrix remain incomplete; fail-closed preflight is not a completed runner.
The known installed CLI flag incompatibility prevents live lifecycle verification. No live executor or verifier call was made.
summary: Fail. The allowlist self-test and requested evidence updates are present, and the unsupported-flag stop is appropriate. AC-2 and AC-6 remain unmet. Two small in-scope correctness fixes remain: preserve unknown token usage as null and check exact option tokens in preflight.
